title: The Credit Terms dropdown lists active terms in page order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure Net 50 is deactivated and every other standard term is active. The shop's own active terms include term A (due 10 days after the invoice date) and term B (due on day 5 of the following month), and its own term C is deactivated. Other terms of the shop may also be offered.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • It lists the active terms in the page order: COD first (with a "Default" tag), Due on Receipt second, then the Net terms by days with term A after Net 7 and before Net 15, then Net 15 to Net 120 (Net 50 missing), then the day-of-the-following-month terms with term B among them, and Credit Hold last, with no "Default" tag.
  • Net 50 and term C (inactive) are not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R3: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Customer and Edit Customer lists the shop's active terms in the S1-R5 order. The default carries a "Default" tag after its name.”
  • S5-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a customer not already on them.”
  • S5-N3: “Credit Hold is offered in the dropdown (as today) but never carries the "Default" tag, because it can never be the default.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer: the Credit Terms picker"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p5-03-new-customer-the-credit-terms-picker.png

The design's own words:

  • “The picker lists the active terms in the S1-R5 order: COD, Due on Receipt, Net terms by days (the shop's own Net 10 between Net 7 and Net 15), day-of-month terms by day, any other term A to Z, Credit Hold last. Deactivated terms are not offered.”
  • “The shop default (Due on Receipt) carries the same "Default" tag as the Credit Terms table. Vendor pickers show no tag: the default applies to new customers only.”
